X: the left vertex class of G
Y: the right vertex class of G
N: the neighborhood map defined in the statement
N_G(C): the set of vertices in Y adjacent in G to at least one vertex of C
S: an arbitrary subset of X in the theorem statement
M: a matching saturating X in the necessity direction
m: the injection sending each x in X to its matching partner in Y
A: a nonempty proper subset of X where the neighborhood inequality is tight
T: an arbitrary subset of X minus A, or later of X minus {x}, as locally specified
G_1: the subgraph induced by A union N_G(A)
G_2: the subgraph induced by (X minus A) union (Y minus N_G(A))
M_1: an inductively obtained matching in G_1 saturating A
M_2: an inductively obtained matching in G_2 saturating X minus A
G': the subgraph induced after deleting x and y
M': an inductively obtained matching in G' saturating X minus {x}
